description: This file defines an API service module for the Planet Tracker frontend. It contains functions to compute the backend base URL, perform API GET requests with error handling, and fetch specific data such as NEOs, planets, and health status. It relies on environment variables, window properties, and DOM meta tags to determine the base URL. It also includes utility functions for URL handling and error processing.

methods.name: stripTrailingSlash(u)
methods.description: Removes a trailing slash from a URL string for consistent URL joining.

methods.name: isAbsolute(u)
methods.description: Checks if a URL string is an absolute URL (starts with http:// or https://).

methods.name: joinUrl(base, path)
methods.description: Safely joins a base URL and a relative path into a full URL.

methods.name: toFriendlyError(e)
methods.description: Maps fetch/network errors into simpler, user-friendly Error objects.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params = {})
methods.description: Performs a GET request to a specified API path with query parameters, handles errors, and parses JSON response.

methods.name: quickHealthProbe()
methods.description: Performs a quick check to see if the backend health endpoint is reachable, used during error handling.

methods.name: fetchNeos({ date, page, per_page } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a list of NEOs for a given date with pagination.

methods.name: fetchPlanets({ date } = {})
methods.description: Fetches planetary positions for a given date.

methods.name: fetchHealth()
methods.description: Checks the health status of the backend service.

ctags.name: fetchNeos
ctags.pattern: /^export async function fetchNeos({ date, page, per_page } = {}) {$/
